entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi... um, yes. I think I need to return something? I'm looking at my account online and it's all a bit overwhelming. I'm not sure what I'm supposed to do.
I can definitely help you with that. To get started, could I please have your name and the order number?
Yes, it's Michael Chen. The order number is... VF88-291-04B. It's for that Urban Commuter Helmet.
Thank you, Michael. Let me pull that up. Okay, I see the order for the helmet, delivered on December 15th. It's been about 33 days. Can I ask what specifically is the issue with the item?

Well, it's just... the color. It didn't look like this on my computer. I thought it was a deep navy, but it's more of a royal blue. The box is still unopened, I haven't even taken it out. I just don't like it. The return page has so many rules... can't you just help me?
Of course, Michael. No problem at all. Let me just double-check the return eligibility for that helmet for you. One moment.
Okay, I've checked our policy. For standard gear like this helmet, we have a 90-day return window. Since it's only been 33 days, you are well within the timeframe for a full refund.
Oh! Really? That's wonderful. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it.

Not at all. Since the box is unopened and it's in its original condition, we can absolutely process this for you. We want to make sure you're completely satisfied with your equipment, especially something as important as safety gear. I'm generating a prepaid return label for you right now and I'll send it to the email on file.
Thank you so much, Sarah. You've made this so simple. I really appreciate it.

You're very welcome, Michael. The email should be in your inbox shortly. Just print the label, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
